fields.note: P3 mass against design load is a log-linear fit per item through 052's three loads (97.2-99.7 kPa): SiC tubes ~p^0.445 at the endpoints, PBO ~p^1.0, sleeves ~p^2. The full-range load 103.95 kPa is a 4.3 % extrapolation. 052's ISA payloads are reproduced within 0.06 kg; its force field and sizing were not re-solved.
